formula: baht = tokens x USD per 1,000,000 tokens / 1,000,000 x baht per USD; tokens = characters x measured tokens per 1,000 characters / 1,000

exchange_rate.what: Bank of Thailand weighted-average interbank exchange rate, baht per US dollar

limits: This is token cost only. It says nothing about answer quality.
Token rates were measured on FLORES-200 (news and encyclopedia style text). Chat messages or other kinds of text may tokenize differently.
Output tokens are assumed to have the same tokens-per-character as input text of that language.
Reasoning/thinking tokens, prompt caching, batch discounts, free tiers and long-context price tiers are not included. Standard list prices only.
Claude token rates come from count_tokens, which Anthropic documents as an estimate.
Open models have no per-token price of their own: only their token counts are reported.
The English column is the same content in English: character counts are scaled by the measured English/Thai character ratio of FLORES-200.
Scenario sizes (characters, turns, volumes) are assumptions written in registry/scenarios.toml, not measurements.

scenarios.name: LINE OA customer chatbot, 10,000 conversations a month
